credit.notes: No credit-card product or credit-card blocking channel is published on the bank's official site. The site's 'credit card' mentions are loan schemes, not payment cards: the Kisan Credit Card, issued as a 'Rupay Kisan Debit Card' (https://rscb.bank.in/card-rural/Kisan-Credit-Card, live fetch 2026-11-01), and three 'Swarojgar Credit Card Yojana' rows in the homepage NABARD loan/interest-rate table (finance with NABARD refinancing at NABARD rate + 0.50 margin, or from the bank's own fund at 12%).
